name: @objectstack/console
description: Prebuilt Console SPA built from this workspace's ui/apps/console (@object-ui/console) at the same version, installed as a dependency of @objectstack/cli.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/index.html';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('\n✗ @objectstack/console: '+p+' is missing — run pnpm console:build at the repo root before publishing.\n');process.exit(1)}"
